item.title: My Master's Thesis Defence
item.author: jumulv
item.description:
On 16 September 2026, I had the opportunity to present and defend my Master's Thesis on Modelling Nonlinear Insulin-Glucose Dynamics in Critically-ill Patients!

It was a great opportunity to present my last 8 months of work and to gain crucial constructive criticism from my opponent. It is a bittersweet feeling coming to the final days at my days at KTH, but I'm looking forward to my next endeavour, and will certainly reminisce my two years at this great school.
